statement.zh: 萨卡拉第一王朝大墓发掘续见 Emery《第一王朝大墓》II（1954，EES Memoir 46）。
statement.en: At Saqqara, First Dynasty great-tomb excavations continue to be documented in Emery Great Tombs of the First Dynasty II (1954, EES Memoir 46).
